audit.whatIsWrong: Page calls this a favoured 4/10 matchup with Graves winning six of seven level rows, but the Emerald+ win rate is 45.95% and the packet level chart reads Skill/Graves/Graves/Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox.
audit.why: Aatrox is a drain bruiser who beats Graves in any extended fight once items and World Ender come online; the page's own whys[5] and whys[6] already say he reclaims the lane, so the sides contradicted the prose.
audit.corrected: Even-to-losing: Graves owns levels 2-3, the mid-lane rows are skill, and Aatrox takes over from first item onward. Difficulty 6/10, Aatrox carry threat 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the ults but gave no cooldowns, so 'wait for his R to be down' had no number attached.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80s and Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s; the whole matchup is timed off those windows.
audit.corrected: World Ender (R, 120s at rank 1) is the window — disengage and farm it out. Graves' Collateral Damage is a 100s shell at rank 1, spent on a kill or on peel, never on chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Infernal Chains (W) grounds, which shuts off Quickdraw (E) — Graves' only escape. The page also called Smoke Screen a blind.
audit.why: Aatrox W grounds and drags back to centre; Graves E is a dash, so a landed W removes the exit that the whole trading pattern depends on. Smoke Screen reduces sight range and slows — it does not cause attacks to miss.
audit.corrected: Infernal Chains (W, 20s at rank 1) grounds you — once it lands, Quickdraw (E, 16s at rank 1) cannot take you out, so never step in with W up. Umbral Dash (E, 9s at rank 1) is his re-engage and heals him on damage, so he buys back the spacing you win. Smoke Screen cuts his sight and slows; it does not blind his autos.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves' Q carries a derived 'terrain: creates terrain' flag.
audit.why: Riot's description says the shell detonates on colliding with terrain — it does not create terrain. Tooltip-parsing misfire.
audit.corrected: No change written to the page; flag noted as unreliable.

audit.why: Nothing verifiable in the brief about 26.15 changes to either kit.

edits.after: Level 1 is even: all four pellets only land point-blank, and that is exactly where his Darkin Blade swing lands too.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track World Ender; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Even now: two autos and out on the E armor stacks, but Umbral Dash (E, 9s at rank 1) buys back every step of spacing you win.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: His first item and Deathbringer healing outlast your magazine — burst and leave, never brawl into a reload.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: He out-sustains you in any long fight — convert to picks with Smoke Screen sight-denial and R snipes.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Aatrox carry threat 5/10.
edits.after: Skill matchup — difficulty 6/10, Aatrox carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Aatrox carry threat 5/10.
edits.after: Skill matchup — difficulty 6/10, Aatrox carry threat 7/10.

edits.after: Aatrox hits his power window: World Ender (R, 120s at rank 1) amps his healing and stats, so his Q sweetspot trades flip even fights into kills — disengage and farm out the 120 seconds.

edits.before: Dash in with E for the point-blank 4-shell spread, then E out on a stored charge before his third Q sweetspot lands so you never eat the knockup
edits.after: Dash in with Quickdraw (E, 16s at rank 1) for the point-blank spread, then leave on a stored charge before his third Darkin Blade swing knocks you up

notes: Packet defect 'Use Smoke Screen' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Smoke Screen is Graves' own W and the text is correct. Graves Q carries a bad derived flag ('creates terrain'); Riot's text only says it detonates on colliding with terrain — do not build advice on that flag. Level chart flipped as an atomic group across both layers to match the 45.95% Emerald+ win rate and the packet chart; the content whys already described these sides, so no why text needed changing for rows 1, 4, 5 or 7.
